people.name: Mark Edward Rauguth
people.bio_note: Managing Member and CCO of Immaculate Wealth Management, which he founded in Mesa in 2013; over 36 years total in financial services. Began his career in 1986 at American Express Financial Advisors as a registered representative; in 1997 moved to Raymond James Financial Services as an investment adviser and branch manager, building a higher-net-worth and small-business practice. In 2000, while still at RJFS, founded a second entity, Precision Investments, Inc., to handle clients' insurance and annuity needs. Later earned the CFP designation. Holds Series 63 and 65 registrations, licensed in Arizona, California, and Texas.
people.bio_source: immaculatewealth.com (firm's own website states he founded Precision Investments, Inc. in 2000). Indyfin (indyfin.com/financial-advisor/arizona/mesa/mark-rauguth-1564114) independently confirms his employment dates at American Express Financial Advisors (1986-1997) and Raymond James (1997-2013), and lists him at Precision Investments during that period, but does not itself state that he founded it -- that specific detail is firm-stated only.

firm_note.text: Mesa-based RIA founded by Mark Rauguth in 2013; built out of a long individual advisory career rather than a team-based firm.
